title: From idea to a testable product
task: Choose one user problem. Build a small digital prototype and a test that could show the idea is wrong.
deliverable: Problem brief, working prototype, acceptance criteria and a decision log.
data: Public examples or an explicitly licensed, synthetic brief.
review: Can another person run it, explain its limitations and test the central assumption?

title: An assistant that shows its evidence
task: Build a bounded research assistant that cites a fixed document set and identifies questions it cannot answer.
deliverable: Source list, answer rubric, failure cases and an inspectable workflow.
data: A small corpus with documented reuse rights. No private student or client records.
review: Can independent reviewers distinguish supported answers, errors and justified abstentions?

title: A small tool for a public-interest problem
task: Co-define an information or coordination problem with a community organisation. Prototype one low-risk workflow.
deliverable: Stakeholder brief, accessible prototype and a method for evaluating usefulness.
data: Public or synthetic information; no automated eligibility or individual decisions.
review: Does the intended user find it useful, accessible and understandable? Report unmet needs too.
